hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/gifford-pinchot-state-park/stay ('Some sites have full service hook up, which includes: Sewer, Water, Electricity') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880306 (86 public sites list 50-amp, 55 list 30-amp; the 22 Full-Hookup sites list water and sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 285 campsites on the booking site (120 Modern Electric, 143 Modern Non-Electric, 22 Full-Hookup) besides cabins, cottages, yurts and group tenting; DCNR says 289 campsites. All sites have macadam pads; listed max vehicle lengths are mostly 35-45 ft, Loop A has several 60-65 ft sites and the Loop B full-hookup sites run 60-95 ft. Every site is listed back-in.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/gifford-pinchot-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880306 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, driveway type) + the DCNR stay page ('All of the sites have macadam pads'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Starting in 2027 the shower houses are being replaced in phases; parts of the campground close while others stay open, and affected sites are blocked from reservation (DCNR, read 2026-10-20).

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/gifford-pinchot-state-park/stay ('Sanitary dumping stations', 'Modern bathhouses with flush toilets and showers', Campground Rehabilitation Project Update), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window). Up to 14 consecutive nights Memorial Day to Labor Day and 21 the rest of the season, then 48 hours away before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/gifford-pinchot-state-park/stay (maximum stay) + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/gifford-pinchot-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880306 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window/14-night max for this park; season (mid-April to late October) already manual. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at 22 full-hookup sites, 285 sites (lengths to 95 ft on Loop B full-hookup, all back-in), showers/flush toilets/dump, and the 2027 phased shower-house renovation as a facilities note. Not stated for this park: the Saturday 2-night summer minimum (left inherited), the noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
